Founded in 2011, we offer our audience everything from breaking news to reviews to award-winning features and investigations, on our site, in video, and in podcasts. 2026-11-27T17:54:10+00:00 https://www.theverge.com/rss/index.xml https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2025/01/verge-rss-large_80b47e.png?w=150&h=150&crop=1 Sheena Vasani https://www.theverge.com/?p=1039645 2026-11-27T11:41:19-05:00 2026-11-27T12:30:00-05:00 What can you get for $30 these days? When it comes to tech, you might be surprised. Even as gadgets get more expensive, $30 can still go a long way, especially on Black Friday. For just $8, for instance, TP-Link’s Tapo smart plug will let you control the Christmas tree lights from your phone. You can also grab a decent pair of ANC-equipped earbuds for under $20, or spend even less on a clever set of rechargeable AA batteries . And it’s not just gadgets that are on sale: you can even sign up for a year of Disney Plus and Hulu for $4.99 ($8 off) a month. Below, we’ve rounded up the best Black Friday deals for $30 or less, from charging accessories and smart home tech to earbuds, streaming subscriptions, games, and more. Whether you’re looking for practical stocking stuffers or want to treat yourself without spending too much, these are the deals that won’t put a (huge) dent in your wallet. Apple AirTag (second-gen) Apple’s latest AirTags feature an upgraded ultra-wideband chip for more precise location tracking, a noticeably louder speaker, and an expanded Bluetooth range. Read our review. Where to Buy: $29 $18 at Amazon $29 $18 at Walmart $29 $18 at Best Buy SwitchBot Bot Rechargeable Do you ever wish you could turn on your coffee maker or hit the light switch without getting up? The SwitchBot Bot lets you do that. All you need to do is stick the inexpensive contraption on a standard button or rocker switch, which will allow you to control or schedule your pet feeder, garage door, and a wide range of other devices from your smartphone. Where to Buy: $33.99 $23.99 at Amazon (white) $33.99 $23.8 at SwitchBot (with code BFCMX30) $33.99 $23.99 at Amazon (black) Disney Plus, Hulu Bundle You can get an ad-supported Disney Plus and Hulu bundle for $4.99 a month ($8 off) for an entire year. Both streaming services feature a deep catalog of new and classic TV shows and movies, including The Simpsons , Andor , Toy Story 5 , and The Fantastic Four: First Steps . Where to Buy: $12.99 $4.99 at Hulu (ad-supported, monthly) $21.99 $14.99 at Hulu (ad-free, monthly) Zepath USB-C Li-ion AA Batteries Rechargeable AA batteries are handy until it’s time to charge them. Most wall chargers let you refill four, maybe six, at once. Zepath’s clever solution is to ship them in an easy-to-use USB-C charging case that charges eight simultaneously. The batteries themselves are long-lasting, too. Where to Buy: $19.99 $15.99 at Amazon (8-pack, 3000mWh) $31.99 $23.99 at Amazon (12-pack, 3000mWh) Hoto 3.6V Electric Screwdriver Kit Pro Hoto’s rechargeable screwdriver is ideal for small repairs. It offers three torque modes, a rotational speed of up to 220RPM, and a helpful circular LED to illuminate dark spaces. The durable case also holds all 25 steel bits and an extension bar for getting into hard-to-reach places. Where to Buy: $49.99 $28.48 at Amazon $49.99 $28.48 at Walmart HBO Max An HBO Max Basic subscription provides access to shows like A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms, The Last of Us, and The Pitt , as well as films like Superman and Weapons. You can get a year of the monthly, ad-supported subscription for $5.49 a month (about $6 off) until December 1st. Where to Buy: $10.99 $5.49 at HBO Max (monthly, with ads) $109.99 $78.99 at HBO Max (annual, basic) $184.99 $132.99 at HBO Max (annual, standard) Amazon Fire TV Stick 4K Plus Amazon’s last-gen Fire TV Stick 4K Plus streams in 4K and supports Dolby Atmos, Dolby Vision, and Alexa Plus. It also ships with the redesigned Fire OS and, unlike more recent models, still lets you sideload Android TV apps. Where to Buy: $69.99 $29.99 at Amazon $69.99 $29.99 at Best Buy LifeStraw Sip The original LifeStraw was designed for those heading into the backcountry. The new LifeStraw Sip? Not so much. The reusable steel straw is geared more toward travelers than outdoor enthusiasts, though fortunately it still manages to remove about 99.99 percent of microplastics, bacteria, and parasites from your drinking water. Where to Buy: $34.95 $24.47 at Amazon $34.95 $26.21 at LifeStraw TP-Link Tapo Matter-Certified Smart Plug Mini TP-Link’s Wi-Fi smart plug lets you remotely control lamps, fans, and other appliances using your phone or voice commands. It supports Matter, so it works with all major smart home platforms to set schedules and timers to automatically turn devices on or off. Where to Buy: $19.99 $7.99 at Amazon $23.99 $14.99 at Amazon (two-pack) CMF Buds 2A With 12.4mm drivers, active noise cancellation, and an IP54 rating, the CMF Buds 2A offer high-end features at an affordable price. You can also customize the sound, adjust ANC levels, and find the earbuds using the Nothing X app. Where to Buy: $49 $17.89 at Amazon (black) $49 $19.99 at Amazon (orange) $49 $19.99 at Amazon (light gray) Peacock Peacock is a great way to catch up on a wealth of content from NBC’s various networks, whether you plan to rewatch The Office or catch up on all things Bravo. A Premium subscription also grants access to films from studios like Universal Pictures and Dreamworks, along with live sports and a host of Peacock Originals. Kodak’s charming, keychain-friendly tchotchke lets you snap lo-fi memories on a whim, with an ultra-small 1.6-megapixel sensor, a built-in LED flash, and the tiniest amount of storage. Where to Buy: $34.99 $29.74 at Amazon $34.99 $29.74 at B&H Photo Catan (6th Edition) In Catan , up to four players strategically compete and trade for resources. The iconic board game ends when one player reaches 10 “victory points,” which is achieved by constructing a sprawling civilization of roads, settlements, and cities using sheep, ore, wheat, and wood. Where to Buy: $54.99 $24.99 at Amazon $54.99 $24.99 at Target Azul Azul is a game in which you arrange patterned tiles in order to create the most beautiful tapestry possible. Arranging tiles in a strategic sequence will help you build your score while limiting your opponents’ ability to grow theirs. Where to Buy: $39.99 $22.49 at Amazon $39.99 $24.99 at Target Halo: Campaign Evolved Halo: Campaign Evolved lets you revisit the original Halo: Combat Evolved campaign with better graphics, updated controls, and improved sound. The well-crafted remake also adds three new missions starring Master Chief and Sgt. Johnson, which take place before the main campaign. Read our review . It features USB-C charging and has an adjustable clip.
